title: Surreal Eye of Dreams
description: A large stylized human eye dominates the surreal landscape, its iris containing a night scene with a small boat carrying two figures on calm water under a red moon. Above the eye, a woman in a patterned robe walks across sand dunes carrying a lantern while a large mouse sits on the upper eyelid; below, water cascades from the eye into a stream surrounded by colorful flowers and smaller mice.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a giant human eye set in a desert landscape, inside the iris a small wooden boat with two figures floats on water under a blood red moon, above the eye a woman in a black patterned robe walks across sand dunes holding a glowing lantern beside a large grey mouse perched on the eyelid, water flows like tears from the eye into a stream below filled with orange poppies, purple flowers and smaller mice, night sky with large detailed moon, intricate linework, vibrant yet dark color palette.
